{"action":"QUERY","sql":"WITH south_customers AS (SELECT c_rxwmxc FROM r_riisnw WHERE c_aqsnze = 1 AND c_eczbnf = 'South'),

                      JOIN south_customers sc ON o.c_npjdan = sc.c_rxwmxc

                      GROUP BY o.c_yqaavf
                      HAVING gross_value > 0)
SELECT COALESCE((SUM(total_refunds) / SUM(gross_value)) * 100.0, 0) AS refund_percentage
FROM qualified_orders","params":{}}
